app.name: OSI Time Tracker
app.statusReady: Extension is loaded. Open Options to approve a website and tracker destination.
app.languageStorageFailed: The language preference could not be saved or loaded. Select the language again to retry.
app.refreshHint: Refresh existing OSI tabs after changing website approvals.

approvals.httpWarning: HTTP destinations send tracker credentials without encryption. Prefer HTTPS unless this is local development.
approvals.denied: Permission was denied. Existing approvals are unchanged; approve again to retry.
approvals.repaired: Setup refreshed. Reload your OSI tabs to reconnect.
approvals.loadFailed: Could not read approvals or browser permissions. Reload and retry setup before making changes.
approvals.changeFailed: The change could not be fully completed. The list shows the latest saved approvals. Reload and retry setup to finish permission and bridge cleanup.
approvals.setupFailed: Approvals are saved, but the website bridge could not be configured. Reload and retry setup, then refresh your OSI tabs.
approvals.missingPermission: Some saved approvals lack browser site access. Restore access using the affected row in setup; approvals alone do not enable access.
approvals.websitePermissionMissing: Website access missing — restore it in Approved websites.
approvals.websiteRequired: Approve a website before adding a tracker.
approvals.websiteHelp: Use only the website origin, e.g. https://time.example.com or http://localhost:3000. HTTPS is required except for loopback addresses.
approvals.destinationHelp: Use the full tracker base URL, including https:// (or http://) and any installation path, e.g. https://tracker.example.com/redmine. Do not include credentials, query parameters, or fragments.
approvals.invalidWebsite: Enter an origin with https://, or http:// for localhost/loopback. Remove paths, credentials, query parameters, and fragments.
approvals.invalidDestination: Enter a valid http:// or https:// tracker base URL. Installation paths are allowed; credentials, query parameters, fragments, and traversal paths are not.

error.extensionUnavailable: The OSI extension is not available in this browser.
error.extensionIncompatible: This website needs a newer OSI extension.
error.extensionPermissionRequired: The extension needs permission for this site or tracker.
error.extensionUnknownCreate: The time entry may already exist on the tracker. Confirm before retrying.
error.extensionMalformed: The extension rejected an invalid message.
error.extensionLimitExceeded: The extension stopped the request because a safety limit was reached.
error.extensionDestinationUnapproved: This tracker destination is not approved.
error.extensionOriginUnapproved: This website is not approved to use the extension.
